session_lead: One button walks you through four blocks: a warm-up, one target skill, consolidation and real text.
session_needs_level: First choose your starting level on Today; a session cannot be built without it.
session_expected_note: Worked out from your current speed so a full run fits in 15 to 25 minutes. If you are short of time you can leave at any point: attempts already finished are kept.
session_block_warmUp_body: An exercise built around the weakest transitions between keys from your earlier attempts.
session_block_warmUp_fallback: No weak transitions have shown up yet, so the warm-up runs on the target skill.
session_block_target_body: The exercise your next action points to: one skill, with the keyboard guide on.
session_block_consolidation_body: The same skill as test attempts with no guide; they count toward mastery.
session_block_realText_body: Last, real sentences from the Academy made of your open keys. While too few keys are open, real words from open keys.
session_abandon_note: Attempts already finished stay recorded; an interrupted one produces nothing.
session_finished_body: {count} attempts were recorded in this session. The summary and your next action are on Today.
session_realtext_kind_sentences: Sentences from the Academy. Every letter in them is already open.
session_realtext_kind_closest: The Academy sentences closest to your keys. Not open yet: {chars}.
session_realtext_kind_words: Words from open keys. Too few keys are open for whole sentences, so these are real words, not made-up ones.
session_realtext_none: Too few keys are open for real text yet. You can finish the session: everything typed is saved.
session_realtext_done: Text typed. The session is ready to finish.
session_realtext_skip_note: You can finish without it too: everything typed is saved.
session_realtext_not_ready: The text for this block cannot be built right now. Go back to the session to finish it.
